rounds.literal: Umuntu ubambe inkunzi enkulu ngeempondo, amehlo avulekile, abantu babaleka emuva kwakhe.
rounds.story: Kutjhiwo nakuvele kufanele umuntu angajiki, aqalane nomraro ngokuqondileko esikhundleni sokuwubalekela.

rounds.literal: Umntwana uthela idada ngamanzi, amanzi adudule phasi idada laqhubeka litjhidela.
rounds.story: Kusetjenziswa lokha nasele umuntu ayalwa nofana akhuzwa kodwana kungabi natjhuguluko nakancani.

rounds.literal: Imbila igijima ithwele imilayezo, kuthi umsila wayo usale ubhajwe emnyango.
rounds.story: Abantu bakutjho nakumuntu ohlala athunywa nofana angenele izinto zabanye agcine eselahlekelwe.

rounds.literal: Abantu bagawula induku ehle kude nekhaya, bayiletha bayibuka bathabile.
options: into enhle ivela lapho abantu bazalana khona
rounds.story: Isetjenziswa ukukhumbuza abantu ukuthi ubuhle, ulwazi nofana umsizi kungavela ngaphandle kwekhaya.

rounds.literal: Amathole amancani ame aqine, abantu baqalaza sengathi sele babona iinkunzi ezinkulu.
rounds.story: Kutjhiwo lokha nakukhulunywa ngabentwana nabatjha njengabazakuba namandla nekusasa.

rounds.literal: Indoda iphethe isilonda, umuntu oseceleni ufuna ukuhleka kanti abanye bayamkhandla.
rounds.story: Lena isetjenziswa ukuvimba ukuhleka umuntu osebuhlungwini, nanyana ezama ukuqina.

rounds.literal: Amaqili amabili ahlala phambi kwesitja, omunye nomunye ufihla isipunu ngaphasi kwehembe.
rounds.story: Kusetjenziswa nakuvela ukungathembani phakathi kwabantu abajayele ubuqili nofana ukukhohlisa.

rounds.literal: Inyoni encani yakha isidleke ngoboya obuthathwe kwezinye iinyoni, iphaphazela izere.
options: umuntu angaphumelela ngosizo nofana ngelwazi lwabanye
rounds.story: Isetjenziswa nakuvele ukuthi ukuphumelela kuvame ukwakhiwa ngezandla, imicabango nofana usizo lwabanye.

rounds.literal: Isisu somfana siyakhononda, bese aphendula ikati ngelaka ngoba usalambile.
rounds.story: Kutjhiwo nakubonakala umuntu asiba nomsindo ngebanga lokulamba nofana ukungabi nalutho.

rounds.literal: Ukhamba oluncani luhlezi eduze kwembiza enkulu, zombili zifana ngombala nangokubunjwa.
rounds.story: Lena itjhiwo nakubonakala isimilo, ubuso nofana indlela yomntwana ifana neyababelethi.

kids.literal: Izandla ezimbili ziphalazana amanzi esingwini, sengathi zigezana zodwa.
kids.story: Kutjhiwo lokha abantu nabancedana emsebenzini nofana enkingeni.

kids.literal: Umntwana umi endleleni abuze ugogo ophambi kwakhe ukuthi ahambe ngaphi.
kids.story: Lena isifundisa ukubawa iseluleko kubantu abanesipiliyoni.

kids.literal: Umfana umi yedwa, bese abantu abanengi bamphakamisa amomotheka.
kids.story: Kutjhiwo nasikhumbuzwa ukuba nomusa, ukuhlonipha nokusekela abanye.

kids.literal: Ikati elihlakaniphile lizama ukuzikhotha emhlana, lajika lajika lahluleka.
options: wonke umuntu udinga usizo ngesinye isikhathi
kids.story: Kutjhiwo nakukhunjuzwa ukuthi akakho ongazenzela koke yedwa.

kids.literal: Umuntu ugoba ihlanga elisemanzini kalula, kodwana elomile alisafuni ukugoba.
kids.story: Lena isetjenziswa ekufundiseni isimilo esihle kusenesikhathi.

kids.literal: Umfana akalaleli, bese sekwephuza ubona ngedolo elilimazekileko.
kids.story: Kutjhiwo nakumuntu ongafuni ukuzwa iseluleko, agcine ebone ngemiphumela emimbi.

kids.literal: Indlovu enkulu ihamba kuhle, umsila wayo umncani ulandela emuva.
kids.story: Lena itjhiwo lokha umuntu osele enomsebenzi omkhulu angeze asindwe kokuncani okungeziweko.

kids.literal: Intuthwane encani ithwele iqabunga elikhulu, kodwa iya phambili ingemi.
kids.story: Kusetjenziswa ukukhuthaza umuntu ukuthi umsebenzi wakhe angawenza nanyana mkhulu.

kids.literal: Umntwana ulele athule esibelethweni, kanti akekho obonako ukuthi ufuna ukusizwa.
kids.story: Lena ifundisa abentwana ukubika nxa banenkinga nofana befuna usizo.

kids.literal: Inja ihlezi ithemba umnikazi wayo, kanti nguye oyisondezako engozini.
kids.story: Kutjhiwo nakubonakala ukuthi umonakalo omkhulu ungavela kumuntu oseduze nawe.
